mutation_catalog.sequence: IMPORT de segunda captura I26 B ya confirmada y distinta de A; selecciona nuevo source_id y sube selection_generation.

mutation_catalog.name: SOURCE_REVIEW_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: SOURCE A ACCEPT v1 → REVOKE v2 → ACCEPT v3; decisión vuelve a ACCEPT, versión no vuelve a1.

mutation_catalog.name: EVALUATION_REVOKE
mutation_catalog.sequence: EVALUATION del paquete ACCEPT v1 → REVOKE v2.

mutation_catalog.name: EFFECT_REVOKE
mutation_catalog.sequence: EFFECT del paquete ACCEPT v1 → REVOKE v2.

mutation_catalog.name: SOURCE_SELECTION_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: Precapturar SOURCE B; seleccionar A→B→A. source_generation+2 aunque el source_id final sea A.

mutation_catalog.name: SOURCE_REVIEW_REVOKE
mutation_catalog.sequence: SOURCE manifest del BATCH ACCEPT v1 → REVOKE v2.

mutation_catalog.name: BATCH_REVIEW_REVOKE
mutation_catalog.sequence: BATCH manifest ACCEPT v1 → REVOKE v2; no sustituir por PROJECTION REVOKE de RV20.

mutation_catalog.name: PROFILE_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: Perfil A→None→A; profile_generation+2 y source conserva pin de generación anterior.

mutation_catalog.name: POLICY_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: Política A required_horizon5 → B4 → A5, demás campos idénticos; policy_generation+2.

mutation_catalog.name: OBSERVATION_SELECTION_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: Observación B válida y distinta ya registrada antes de preparar EVALUATION; seleccionar A→B→A en el mismo slot. account_generation+2, selected final A.

mutation_catalog.name: OBSERVATION_REVOKE
mutation_catalog.sequence: Revocar observación seleccionada A por generation exacta; account_generation+1, revoked=True.

mutation_catalog.name: ADAPTER_ABA
mutation_catalog.sequence: Adapter A→B con release sintético distinto→A; binding inmutable, account_generation+2 y descriptor final A.

mutation_catalog.name: TASK_TITLE
mutation_catalog.sequence: Cambiar título de la TASK proyectada, row_version+1. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: EPIC_TITLE
mutation_catalog.sequence: Cambiar título del EPIC original, sin editar payload TASK. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: REQUIREMENT_HAS_WORK
mutation_catalog.sequence: Marcar has_work=True en REQUIREMENT de fixture; no activar trabajo ni ejecutar grooming real. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: TASK_EPIC_FIELD
mutation_catalog.sequence: Cambiar epic_id de TASK hacia EP2 existente; no reescribir relaciones automáticamente. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: ADD_EPIC_REQUIREMENT
mutation_catalog.sequence: Añadir EP original→REQ2; membresía nueva respecto al baseline. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: ADD_TASK_EPIC
mutation_catalog.sequence: Añadir TASK0→EP2; membresía nueva respecto al baseline. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: ADD_DEPENDENCY_HARD
mutation_catalog.sequence: Añadir TASK0→TASK2, kind HARD, sin arista previa o ciclo. data_generation+1, data_hash cambia; selección/PROJECTION previas no se renuevan.

mutation_catalog.name: ADD_DEPENDENCY_SOFT
